text:
pagerduty-bot: SEV2 — inference-route-us-east-1a high error rate (5xx) and token-latency spike detected. impact: 18% increased 5xx on /v1/generate, elevated p95 latency. auto-page: ops-oncall.

sarah.kim: seeing the same in console. errors started ~6264999980, sustained. traces show connection resets and long write waits to local resolver.

rajiv: jumping in — ssh-ing to a few g5 nodes in us-east-1a. kernel shows tx retransmit spikes, NIC tx-queue growing. route table looks ok. suspect AZ-local resolver/backplane slowness.

maria.v: from instances: repeated DNS timeouts, slow TCP connects to backend proxies. iostat shows high iowait on /dev/nvme0n1 for 3 instances. could be host-level egress contention.

leo: yes, our inference runtime is seeing KV cache miss storms because some KV-pop nodes report slow disk IO. combined with resolver timeouts, requests get retried and amplify load.

ops-oncall: immediate mitigation plan — (1) stop sending new traffic to us-east-1a via routing policy (control plane), (2) drain pods/instances in us-east-1a for affected pools, (3) notify customers if latency > slo for >10m. will coordinate.

infra-bot: auto-run health check summary:
```
Failed checks: resolver latency > 250ms (avg 420ms), NIC tx drops > 200/s on 4 hosts, disk iowait > 30% on 3 hosts
Affected pools: inference-gen-1a, embedding-bulk-1a
```

rajiv: to reduce blast radius, let's shift 100% of traffic for those pools off the AZ. control plane API call below. running now.

sarah.kim: good. please run a small canary shift first for non-critical routes (10%) to confirm downstream capacity. we don't want to overload other AZs.

rajiv: running canary -> 10% to us-east-1b for gen, 0% to 1a. cmd:
```
curl -X POST "https://internal-api.redwood/route-shift" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"service":"inference-gen","from":"us-east-1a","to":"us-east-1b","percent":10}'
```

leo: monitoring metrics — p95 for gen on 1b increased by 12ms after canary 10%. no errors. good to ramp.

maria.v: while shifting, I'm triggering instance drains in 1a to let KV caches repopulate in other AZs. drain command:
```
rcctl drain --pool inference-gen-1a --affect 100
```

cs-notify: drafting customer note for affected customers (embedding-heavy workloads). will push to status page if impact persists >15m.

eng-lead: remind: do not change DNS TTLs here — propagation is slow and might route new requests back into the bad AZ. use control plane routing/ELB weights.

rajiv: ramping to 50% now. keeping an eye on token retry rate & request queue depth.

ops-oncall: after 50% ramp, seeing fewer 5xx from global LB. token_retry_rate down 60%, overall error rate down to baseline.

maria.v: disk and NIC counters on the 3 bad hosts still show elevated iowait and tx drops. filing host eviction for those instances and requesting replacement capacity in us-east-1b.

ops-oncall: started replacement -> spinning up 6 replacement instances in us-east-1b as spare capacity. ETA ~6m.

infra-bot: autoscaler event: +6 instances launched in us-east-1b (ids: i-0a1, i-0a2, i-0a3). healthchecks passing.

leo: KV cache regen looks healthy on 1b. request latency stabilizing. we should keep traffic off 1a until host-level postmortem.

sarah.kim: agree. set routing policy to 0% to us-east-1a for affected pools and keep for rollforward.

rajiv: applied full redirect for inference-gen and embedding-bulk. cmd:
```
curl -X POST "https://internal-api.redwood/route-shift" -d '{"service":"inference-gen,embedding-bulk","from":"us-east-1a","to":"us-east-1b","percent":100}'
```

cs-notify: posted initial status update: "Investigating increased inference errors in US East AZ. Traffic being redirected; customers may see transient errors or latency." link: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/6265000000

ops-oncall: handing off to infra team for root cause and long-term remediation. oncall transfer: ops-oncall -> rajiv. I'm leaving a runbook note with steps taken and metrics.

rajiv: taking over. next steps: collect host kernel logs, EBS performance metrics, and cloud provider network events for us-east-1a during window. will coordinate postmortem and customer comms.

maria.v: saving iostat/netstat logs to /var/log/incidents/6265000000/ and uploading to S3 for analysis.

eng-lead: thanks team. after handoff, set follow-up action item: evaluate control plane safeguards to auto-redispatch traffic when resolver latency > X and disk iowait > Y, to avoid manual intervention next time.

ops-oncall: closing pager. If anything regresses, re-alert. tagging for postmortem: region-us-east-1a, root-candidate: host-iowait+resolver-latency.

sarah.kim: noted. great quick coordination everyone :thumbsup: 

pagerduty-bot: incident resolved for routing; mitigation: traffic removed from us-east-1a, replacement capacity added in us-east-1b, customer notifications sent. severity downgraded.

rajiv: will lead the RCA and include timeline + remediation plan. handoff complete.
